segments.he:
א.

עַל־יְדֵי הַחֲנֻפָּה בָּא לִידֵי נִבּוּל־פֶּה, וְהוּא הַדִּין לְהֵפֶךְ.
segments.en: Through adulation, one comes into the grip of foul language, and the opposite is also true.

segments.he:
ב.

עַל־יְדֵי חֲנֻפָּה נַעֲשֵׂית אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָה וּבָנָיו יְתוֹמִים וְאֵין מְרַחֵם עֲלֵיהֶם.
segments.en: Through adulation, one's wife becomes a widow, and his children orphans, and no one has compassion on them.

segments.he:
ד.

מִי שֶׁהוֹלֵךְ בַּשּׁוּק וְנוֹפֵל, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ חֲנֻפָּה.
segments.en: Someone who walks in the marketplace and falls, it is certain that he has adulation in him.

segments.he:
ו.

מִי שֶׁבִּטְחוֹנוֹ עַל אֲחֵרִים, בָּא לִידֵי חֲנֻפָּה.
segments.en: Someone who relies on others, comes into the grip of adulation.

segments.he:
ז.

מִי שֶׁשּׁוֹמֵר אֶת עַצְמוֹ מֵחֲנֻפָּה, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּא לוֹ יְשׁוּעָה.
segments.en: One who guards himself from adulation, through this, salvation comes to him.
It is permitted to adulate wicked people in this world.

segments.he:
י.

גַּם תְּפִלָּתוֹ אֵינ ָהּ  נִשְׁמַעַת וּמָאוּס בְּעֵינֵי כֹּל.
segments.en: Also, one's prayer is not heard, and one becomes repulsive in everyones' eyes.

segments.he:
יב.

עַל־יְדֵי חֲנֻפָּה בָּא לִידֵי כְּפִירָה.
segments.en: Through adulation, one comes into the grip of heresy.
